events.title: Elvis Presley: A Legacy Remembered
events.blurb: Marking 49 years since the passing of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91.

angles.name: The King's Enduring Sound
angles.copy: It's 49 years since we lost the King, Elvis Presley. His music still moves us. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: An anniversary tribute to the influential rapper, Tupac Shakur, who was shot dead in Las Vegas in 1996 and would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost Tupac Shakur. His words and music continue to resonate. What's his most impactful lyric for you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Still Electric
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist, Jimi Hendrix, on the anniversary of his passing in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: It's 56 years since the world lost Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work changed everything. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years of Abbey Road! That cover, those tracks... still sounds fresh. What's your favourite song from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he sang?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The message is as powerful today as it was then. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod: 25 Years On
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, it changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Your Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who's your ultimate 007 and why?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment of his genius?

events.title: The White Album: 58 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking 'White Album' was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years of The White Album! So diverse, so experimental. What are your must-listen tracks from this double masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: A tribute to the incomparable Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Voice
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the magnificent Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence are unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song he fronted?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: 61 years of Rubber Soul! This album marked a real shift for The Beatles. What's your favourite track from this classic?
